headline: Barry Callebaut Flavourcode, Planet A cocoa replacer; Roquette, Palsgaard launches; FDA salt rule
summary: Barry Callebaut's Flavourcode puts controlled cocoa fermentation on the market as a flavour-design tool, a direct challenge to Belcolade's fermentation work that calls for a gap assessment.

Planet A Foods' high-fibre Cocoa Booster can replace up to 100% of cocoa powder and, with Oobli and Cosun's chocolate sugar replacer and Win-Win's mass-market pitch, shows cocoa-saving alternatives scaling fast against Belcolade.

Roquette's Wellence GF 1229 for gluten-free bread and Palsgaard's powder cake emulsifiers are competitor launches to benchmark against Puratos gluten-free mixes and cake improvers, as free-from bakery consolidates (Baker & Baker buys Lazy Day Foods).
FDA has cleared salt substitutes in more standardized foods including breads, effective December 2026, a sell-in moment for Puratos salt-reduction solutions.
Pressure for a federal ultra-processed food definition and GRAS reform keeps rising, so Puratos should have clean-label reformulation options and US ingredient dossiers ready.

items.title: Barry Callebaut debuts its approach to cocoa fermentation
items.summary: Barry Callebaut presents its controlled cocoa fermentation approach for designing chocolate flavour.
items.why: A direct competitor move in controlled cocoa fermentation, the area Belcolade is working on; assess the gap and accelerate Belcolade's own fermentation-flavour offer.

items.title: Mark Golder: ‘Cacao-based chocolate will become increasingly premium, and for everything else, there's Win-Win’
items.summary: Interview with Mark Golder of Win-Win, a cocoa-free chocolate start-up, arguing cacao chocolate will turn premium while alternatives take the mass market.
items.why: A cocoa-free chocolate start-up positioning for the mass market is a partnership target or competitor for Belcolade compounds.

items.title: Barry Callebaut rewrites the chocolate flavor playbook with Flavourcode
items.summary: Barry Callebaut's Flavourcode uses controlled fermentation to create new, consistent chocolate flavours.
items.why: A direct competitor move in controlled cocoa fermentation, the area Belcolade is working on; assess the gap and accelerate Belcolade's own fermentation-flavour offer.

items.title: New cocoa powder alternative targets GLP-1 trends and supply risks
items.summary: Planet A Foods launched Cocoa Booster, a high-fibre cocoa powder replacer that can replace up to 100% of cocoa in some uses.
items.why: Cocoa-cost relief with a fibre claim is a direct competitor to Belcolade cocoa-saving solutions; consider evaluating or partnering.

items.title: Hydrocolloid system addresses gluten-free challenges
items.summary: Roquette's Wellence GF 1229 hydrocolloid system is marketed to improve volume and crumb structure in gluten-free bread.
items.why: A large ingredient competitor entering gluten-free bakery texture; benchmark it against Puratos gluten-free mixes and improvers.

items.title: Starch-based bigels with enhanced freeze–thaw stability as anti-staling butter substitutes in bread
items.summary: A study develops starch-based bigels with good freeze-thaw stability as butter substitutes that slow bread staling.
items.why: A fat-replacing, anti-staling structure for bread and frozen dough is relevant to Puratos improvers and fat-reduction work.

items.title: Palsgaard launches emulsifier to improve cake quality
items.summary: Palsgaard launched PowderGel 6800, an emulsifier for aeration, crumb structure and mouthfeel in cakes.
items.why: A direct competitor move in cake emulsifiers and improvers; benchmark against Puratos cake mixes and cake improvers.

items.title: A sweet deal or impossible bar? How the sustainable cocoa alternatives stack up
items.summary: An article compares sustainable cocoa alternatives and how they perform.
items.why: A snapshot of the cocoa-alternative landscape Belcolade competes in; check which players customers are hearing about.

items.title: Palsgaard introduces powder-based whipping emulsifier
items.summary: Palsgaard introduced a powder-based whipping emulsifier for cakes.
items.why: A direct competitor move in cake emulsifiers and improvers; benchmark against Puratos cake mixes and cake improvers.

items.title: Cocoa-Free & Alternative Chocolate Market Growth Outlook and Strategic Analysis 2026 to 2035
items.summary: A market-research release forecasting growth of cocoa-free and alternative chocolate to 2035.
items.why: A generic market report confirming demand for cocoa alternatives; useful context for Belcolade's cocoa-saving range, not a specific lead.

items.title: Baker & Baker acquires free-from bakery brand Lazy Day Foods
items.summary: Baker & Baker has acquired Lazy Day Foods, a Scottish free-from and vegan bakery brand.
items.why: A frozen-bakery competitor buying into free-from and vegan sweet goods; a signal for Puratos gluten-free and egg-free mixes.

items.title: American Heart Association Calls for Release of Proposed Federal Definition of Ultra-Processed Foods
items.summary: The American Heart Association urged the US government to release its proposed federal definition of ultra-processed foods.
items.why: A federal UPF definition would hit packaged bread, cakes and confectionery; keep clean-label, fewer-additive reformulation options ready for US customers.

items.title: Organic Acids and Bacterial Communities of Backslopped Sourdough Prepared with Japanese Pear (Pyrus pyrifolia Nakai) Infusion
items.summary: Japanese researchers backslopped sourdough with pear infusion for 56 generations and tracked its acids and bacteria.
items.why: Fruit-initiated sourdough microbiology is relevant to Puratos's sourdough library and starter development.

items.title: Conventional and Emerging Protein Ingredients in Farinaceous Products: Amino Acid Quality, Digestibility, Biological Value, and Functional Performance
items.summary: A review compares conventional and emerging proteins in flour-based products on amino-acid quality, digestibility and functionality.
items.why: A reference for choosing proteins in Puratos protein-enriched bread and bakery mixes.

items.title: China's Anjoy Foods Posts 20% Profit Growth in First Three Quarters, Buys ~60% of Singapore's IFC for NT$990 Million to Push Into Frozen Bakery
items.summary: China's Anjoy Foods is buying about 60% of Singapore's IFC to enter frozen bakery.
items.why: A large Chinese frozen-food group entering frozen bakery is a new competitor or customer for Puratos in Asia.

items.title: High fibre innovation to continue at Warburtons despite axing Fibre Fix range
items.summary: Warburtons is dropping its Fibre Fix range but says high-fibre innovation will continue.
items.why: A major UK bread maker staying committed to fibre is a cue for Puratos fibre-enrichment solutions, despite one line's failure.

items.title: Real Dough brings sourdough pizza to retailers nationwide
items.summary: Real Dough is expanding its sourdough pizza into retailers nationwide in the US.
items.why: Shows sourdough claims spreading into US frozen and retail pizza, a market for Puratos sourdough and Sapore solutions.

items.title: Rheological behaviour, structural recovery and printability of customized chocolate inks for extrusion 3D printing
items.summary: An Indian study tests how the cocoa solids-to-fat ratio affects the rheology and printability of chocolate inks for 3D printing.
items.why: Formulation data for printable chocolate could inform Belcolade decoration products if 3D chocolate printing reaches patisseries.

items.title: Pepperidge Farm taps into trends with Sourdough Cookies
items.summary: Pepperidge Farm has launched sourdough cookies in the US.
items.why: Sourdough moving into sweet biscuits is a product cue for Puratos sourdough flavour ingredients in sweet goods.

items.title: Lazy Day Foods: Scottish free-from and vegan bakery business employing 190 people taken over
items.summary: Scottish free-from and vegan bakery Lazy Day Foods, with 190 staff, has been taken over.
items.why: A free-from bakery consolidation signal for Puratos gluten-free and egg-free solutions.

items.title: Pepperidge Farm Launches Unique Sourdough Cookies in Three Delicious Flavors
items.summary: Pepperidge Farm launched sourdough cookies in three flavours.
items.why: Sourdough moving into sweet biscuits is a product cue for Puratos sourdough flavour ingredients in sweet goods.

items.title: In bakery, fresh department trumps center store
items.summary: FMI data show US shoppers prefer the in-store bakery for freshness and taste and centre-store for price.
items.why: Supports Puratos's in-store bakery offer and freshness messaging to US retail customers.

items.title: Eat Just’s Vegan Liquid Egg Debuts in Sweden Via Kale Foods Partnership
items.summary: Eat Just's plant-based Just Egg is launching in Swedish Coop stores via Kale Foods.
items.why: A scaled plant-based egg widening in Europe is a benchmark for Puratos egg-replacement solutions in cakes.
